items.title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
items.summary: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

items.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
items.summary: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

items.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
items.summary: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

items.title: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
items.summary: Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate join the exchange's planned blockchain market, bringing shareholder records and voting services onchain.

items.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
items.summary: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

items.title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
items.summary: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

items.title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
items.summary: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.

items.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
items.summary: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.

items.title: Crypto's Washington playbook is working. Don't abandon it now.
items.summary: Regardless of how the midterm elections unfold or which party secures the presidency in 2028, our industry must adhere to its established playbook, writes Solana Policy Institute’s Colin McLaren.

items.title: Coinbase downgraded at Morgan Stanley; price target slashed 53% on weak earnings outlook
items.summary: Analyst Michael Cyprys cited weak crypto trading activity and doubts about an earnings recovery.

items.title: New Jersey drops Coinbase staking order ahead of crypto’s midterm test
items.summary: New Jersey lifted its staking ban and dropped a $5 million penalty, clearing the way for Coinbase to restore staking access for users in the US state.

items.title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
items.summary: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.

items.title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
items.summary: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.

items.title: Coinbase hit with 50% price target cut as post-earnings rout deepens
items.summary: Slowing trading activity and fallout from the Binance hack are clouding Coinbase’s revenue prospects, prompting Morgan Stanley to lower its rating on the stock.

items.title: Bitcoin risks drop below $76K as 7% oil slide fails to spark BTC price rally
items.summary: Bitcoin fell around 1.7% on Monday as stocks pared early gains fueled by hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran war.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin wallets show post-hack transfers after $46M theft
items.summary: Brazil’s exchange Mercado Bitcoin paused deposits and withdrawals after a security breach, saying customer funds and data were safe.

items.title: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management
items.summary: The former mobile games company is building out its fund management business in Abu Dhabi as it targets institutional demand for stablecoins and tokenized assets.

items.title: Strategy spends triple its weekly Bitcoin outlay on STRC buybacks
items.summary: Strategy spent $208.2 million buying back STRC preferred shares and $65.5 million on Bitcoin, while allocating $98.5 million to its USD Cash balance.

items.title: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents
items.summary: Who better to judge a dispute between AI agents than a jury of different AI models? That’s the idea behind GenLayer, which is already issuing thousands of judgements each day.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
items.summary: Strive added 124 Bitcoin for about $10 million and now trails Twenty One Capital by 390 BTC for third place among Treasury companies.

items.title: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
items.summary: Onchain investigator ZachXBT says an unidentified EU entity lost more than $106 million from centralized exchange accounts on Sunday,.

items.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
items.summary: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

items.title: Tom Lee Calls Bottom on AI Stock Selloff, Citing Tight Supply and Crypto Resilience
items.summary: The Fundstrat strategist says constraints on AI spending have slowed growth without ending the boom, while crypto’s response to the Binance hack suggests sellers may already be exhausted.

items.title: North Korea Is Laundering Binance Hack Loot at One New Wallet Every 25 Seconds
items.summary: $2.85 billion of the $6.43 billion stolen from Binance has been frozen or seized, compared with about 3% in the Bybit hack, as North Korea’s automated laundering spans 12,000 wallets.

items.title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
items.summary: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.

items.title: Nvidia and Nike Lead Biggest Wave Yet of Tokenized Stock Objections
items.summary: Nvidia, Costco, Nike and nine other companies objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 50.

items.title: Elon Musk Mocks Sam Altman Over Claim Home PCs Are Wasting RAM
items.summary: The OpenAI CEO said it's "quite terrible" for DRAM to sit largely idle in personal computers while AI data centers face a supply crunch.

items.title: Brazil's Largest Exchange Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals After $40 Million Hack
items.summary: Brazil's largest crypto exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after a security incident. Tether froze more than 4.5 million USDT tied to the attack.

items.title: Bitmine Buys More Ethereum as Tom Lee Calls the Binance Hack Bullish
items.summary: The chairman laid out six reasons the market’s “muted” 4% ETH drop after the record Binance theft shows crypto is “increasingly resilient,” as the firm’s stash neared its 5% supply goal.
